mapper.select: -- 수집 성공과 적용 실패를 구분한다. 삭제된 원문을 복원하거나 원문/검수 메모를 반환하지 않는다. SELECT id,source_id,job_status_code,is_selected_for_application,application_status_code,application_error_code, application_attempt_count,application_next_attempt_at,applied_evaluation_id,applied_source_version,applied_attachment_version,rollback_status_code FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY source_id,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 실행 요청 키를 직렬화하며 같은 키로 두 번 적용 대기를 만들지 않는다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),73107))::text
-- 당시 접수 영수증만 읽는다. 완료/중지 상태를 재실행하지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batch_application_actions a WHERE a.idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 다른 배치의 명령 식별자를 조회할 수 없다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batch_application_actions a WHERE a.batch_id=#{batchId} AND a.id=#{actionId}
mapper.insert: -- 사유 원문은 저장하지 않는다. 승인 범위와 재검수 확인 계약의 지문을 이력으로 보존한다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_batch_application_actions(id,batch_id,preview_id,action_code,expected_version,scope_item_count, selected_item_count,deleted_item_count,actor_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) VALUES (#{id},#{batchId},#{previewId},#{actionCode},#{expectedVersion},#{itemCount},#{selectedCount},#{deletedCount},#{actorId},#{key},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash})
mapper.sql: count(1)::integer AS remaining,count(1) FILTER (WHERE application_status_code='PENDING')::integer AS pending, count(1) FILTER (WHERE application_status_code='APPLIED')::integer AS applied, count(1) FILTER (WHERE application_status_code='CONFLICT')::integer AS conflicts, count(1) FILTER (WHERE application_status_code='FAILED')::integer AS failed, count(1) FILTER (WHERE is_selected_for_application)::integer AS selected_remaining
mapper.select: -- 비선택/실패를 원래 전체 분모에서 숨기지 않는다. 삭제 건수는 batch에서 별도 조회한다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_jobs WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.update: -- 처음 승인된 불변 preview를 실행에 고정한다. 이후 명령은 승인 근거를 교체하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='APPLYING',application_approval_id=#{actionId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{version} AND batch_status_code IN ('PREVIEW_READY','PREVIEW_PARTIAL_FAILED') AND application_approval_id IS NULL

-- 정확한 현재 이력에서 선택·적격인 작업만 대기시킨다. 실패 작업/다른 배치/비선택은 그대로 남는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs j SET application_status_code='PENDING',application_preview_id=#{previewId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_batch_preview_items i WHERE j.batch_id=#{batchId} AND i.preview_id=#{previewId} AND i.batch_id=j.batch_id AND i.job_id=j.id AND i.is_selected AND i.is_eligible AND i.readiness_code='READY' AND j.is_selected_for_application AND j.job_status_code='SUCCEEDED' AND j.application_status_code='NOT_REQUESTED'

-- source 작업 transaction과 batch 잠금으로 직렬화한다. 이미 완료된 적용을 취소하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='APPLY_PAUSED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{version} AND batch_status_code='APPLYING' AND application_approval_id IS NOT NULL

-- 완료/충돌/실패를 재시도하거나 preview를 교체하지 않는다. 남은 PENDING 항목은 다시 CAS한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='APPLYING',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{version} AND batch_status_code='APPLY_PAUSED' AND application_approval_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.sql: SELECT j.batch_id,j.id AS job_id,j.source_id,j.policy_id,j.preview_evaluation_id,i.preview_id,i.input_hash,a.actor_id FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_attachment_batches b ON b.id=j.batch_id AND b.batch_status_code='APPLYING' JOIN announcement_attachment_batch_application_actions a ON a.id=b.application_approval_id AND a.batch_id=b.id AND a.action_code='START' JOIN announcement_attachment_batch_preview_items i ON i.preview_id=a.preview_id AND i.preview_id=j.application_preview_id AND i.batch_id=b.id AND i.job_id=j.id WHERE j.application_status_code='PENDING' AND j.is_selected_for_application AND i.is_selected AND i.is_eligible AND b.current_preview_id=a.preview_id AND j.application_attempt_count<3 AND (j.application_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.application_next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: -- 선택만 한다. source→정책→batch 잠금 후 같은 항목을 재검증하므로 여러 scheduler도 중복 적용하지 않는다. ORDER BY b.updated_at,b.id,j.source_id,j.id LIMIT 1
-- 기다리는 동안 중지/다른 worker 완료/다른 preview로 바뀌면 반환하지 않는다. AND j.batch_id=#{batchId} AND j.id=#{jobId}
mapper.update: -- 현재 source와 이전 binding이 같은 경우만 종합 근거로 전환한다. base/기존 운영 공고는 변경하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots s SET current_attachment_evaluation_id=j.preview_evaluation_id,attachment_policy_id=j.policy_id, is_attachment_review_required=true,attachment_row_version=s.attachment_row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.source_id=s.id AND j.application_status_code='PENDING' AND j.is_selected_for_application AND s.classification_row_version=j.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=j.expected_attachment_version AND s.attachment_row_version<2147483647 AND attachment_batch_job_input_unchanged(j.id)

-- 적용 이후 정확한 버전/지문은 조건부 원복의 근거다. 수집 결과/이전 검수 binding은 바꾸지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET application_status_code='APPLIED',applied_evaluation_id=preview_evaluation_id, applied_source_version=expected_source_version,applied_attachment_version=expected_attachment_version+1,applied_input_hash=#{inputHash}, application_error_code=NULL,application_next_attempt_at=NULL,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND application_status_code='PENDING'

-- 입력 충돌은 자동 재분류/강제 적용하지 않는 terminal 결과다. 수집 오류와 분리한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET application_status_code='CONFLICT',application_error_code=#{errorCode},application_next_attempt_at=NULL, row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND application_status_code='PENDING'

-- 실패한 source transaction 밖에서 최대 3회와 30초 backoff를 기록한다. 원문 예외는 저장하지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET application_attempt_count=application_attempt_count+1, application_status_code=CASE WHEN application_attempt_count+1>=3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, application_next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN application_attempt_count+1>=3 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' END, application_error_code='APPLICATION_TRANSACTION_FAILED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId} AND application_status_code='PENDING' AND application_attempt_count<3
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=b.id AND j.application_status_code='PENDING') THEN 'APPLYING' WHEN b.deleted_item_count=0 AND (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=b.id AND j.application_status_code='APPLIED')=b.scope_item_count THEN 'APPLIED' ELSE 'APPLY_PARTIAL_FAILED' END
mapper.update: -- 전체 고정 범위가 성공했을 때만 APPLIED다. 비선택/실패/삭제가 있으면 부분 결과를 유지한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches b SET batch_status_code=,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE b.id=#{batchId} AND b.batch_status_code='APPLYING' AND b.row_version<2147483647

-- 삭제로 모든 대기가 사라진 배치도 종료 집계한다. 중지 배치는 자동 재개하지 않는다. WITH ready AS (SELECT b.id FROM announcement_attachment_batches b WHERE b.batch_status_code='APPLYING' AND b.application_approval_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.batch_id=b.id AND j.application_status_code='PENDING') ORDER BY b.updated_at,b.id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches b SET batch_status_code=,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM ready WHERE b.id=ready.id AND b.row_version<2147483647
